bio: Don’t be fooled by the rather unassuming exterior, as once inside you are transported to a totally different world... a world of beer! Sit in one of the booths and enjoy a premium beer (some of which are brewed on site), while studying the proudly local, meat-driven menu. The homemade sausages are outstanding, as is the Mangalitsa, and there’s a myriad of different steaks – all of which arrive in generous portions. Service is endearing, and comfortable apartments complete the picture.This restaurant is temporarily closed for refurbishment....
